# Project Memory

This area stores **short, traceable summaries of active software projects or bounded engineering outcomes** (PARA Projects). It is deliberately project-agnostic.

## Generated by the workflows

- `10-projects/<project-slug>.md`: onboarding summary, architecture pointers, known risks, and last review date.
- `10-projects/progress/<project-slug>.md`: current development checkpoint, blockers, checks, and next steps. Created when `save-progress` is invoked or there is an actual ongoing work checkpoint to preserve.

Both files are ordinary Markdown. The agent should [onboard](../workflows/project-onboarding.md), [save progress](../workflows/save-progress.md), [resume](../workflows/resume-progress.md), or [sync knowledge](../workflows/sync-knowledge.md) according to the user's command. With a discoverable connection, [ordinary development](../workflows/development-lifecycle.md) should retrieve task-relevant project memory and selectively update only material, verified, authorized knowledge.

**Project-owned facts remain in the original codebase.** This folder holds concise verified summaries and relative links, not wholesale copies of code/docs. If two projects share a name, do not overwrite an existing project's note; use a disambiguated slug after checking identity.

Do not persist secrets, unapproved proprietary details, personal data, or business records. See [knowledge conventions](../docs/knowledge-conventions.md).
